acquisition method: The whole analysis was conducted in data-dependent acquisition with individual MS scan followed by ten fragmented MS/MS scans in dynamic exclusion time of 20 s.
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 40 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature in the dark for 30 min.
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 40 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature in the dark for 30 min.
cleavage agent: 1 μg of trypsin in 50 mM TEAB was then added onto the column and incubated at 37 °C overnight.
collision energy: high-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation by the 27% of normalized collision energy.
enrichment method: Proteins eluted from His6-tagged NEDD8 conjugation was reduced with 20 mM dithiothreitol at 95 °C for 10 min
fragmentation method: high-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation by the 27% of normalized collision energy.
instrument: MS spectra were monitored by Q-ExactiveTM (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
mass analyzer: hybrid quadrupole-orbitrap MS coupled with Ultimate-3000 HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
precursor tolerance: Precursor and fragment mass error tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Precursor and fragment mass error tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da, respectively.
ptm: Peptide dynamic modifications allowed during the search were oxidation (M), deamination (N, Q), and acetylation (N-terminus), whereas carbamidomethyl (C) was set as static modifications.
reduction reagent: Proteins eluted from His6-tagged NEDD8 conjugation was reduced with 20 mM dithiothreitol at 95 °C for 10 min
reduction concentration: Proteins eluted from His6-tagged NEDD8 conjugation was reduced with 20 mM dithiothreitol at 95 °C for 10 min
